name: tensordot_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::tensordot.out(Tensor self, Tensor other, int[] dims_self, int[] dims_other, *, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!). Contracts selected dimensions and writes the result into out. Tests validate output identity, empty and wrong-shape resize behavior, noncontiguous output storage, dtype and device rejection, and zero-size and size-one contractions.
